action: Keep the strongbox shut until the rescued families and three workers can witness it. Then open it in public, inventory every object aloud, place the contents under the workers' joint custody, and give me only a signed copy of the inventory—not the coin or the weapon.

digest.location: Shadowed & Lawless — segment 11: Pit Trap Room, 30' x 30' square, lamplit

marks.text: You were poisoned; your next save against poison has disadvantage.

powers.agenda: become something other than what it is

fronts.danger: a blight or plague is spreading toward the town

recentLedger.text: ◆ The flawless noble's merchant consortium was retained under a guard seal issued through a higher patron called the Pale Office; rescued families and workers publicly credited Mira instead, and his delayed reflection exposed an undead skull beneath his living guise.

fields.summary: An oilskin packet of copied guard orders naming voice-collection sites, payments, and use of the three-note command key on occupied rooms.

dm.truth: Venn made three copies: Mira carries one, Venn retains one, and the courier carries the third toward another public record.

skin.text: A specific song is being hummed by strangers who've never met. — The same unfamiliar tune, unconsciously, by people across the district who can't say where they learned it.

clock.note: Heat is the default — you're already Burning (Heat 3).

telegraphs.text: Word on the street: Corrupt Guard holds this ground.

scene.description: Reality becomes unreliable; physics fails, impossible geometry manifests, and minds break under the weight of wrongness.

encounter.text: A building is actively collapsing— stone and timber falling into the street, people screaming (rescue workers are forming a line but civilians are still trapped inside)

resolution.method: three-cycle observation and lute-timed rescue line
resolution.objectiveRef: extract civilians without entering the madness cascade

footing.name: Dense Rubble
footing.impact: Collapsed masonry. _Difficult Terrain_. Increases the DC of Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks by 5, and Stealth checks by 2.

finale.revelation: The culprit was hired by someone above them — and that person was hired by someone else; the chain goes higher than the party can currently reach.
finale.exitState: Someone else claims the victory — a local noble, the city guard, a merchant consortium. Your name fades while others grow fat on the credit. The district celebrates the wrong heroes.

sceneFrame.tactical: 25' drop; water channel on inside (narrow, DC 10 to balance).

boss.archetype: Lich pretending to be living noble (undead hidden beneath perfection; unmasking changes fight entirely)
